description: The pie chart represents a breakdown of time between two categories, showing a total of 2 slices: an orange slice labeled “60.9s (69.92%)” and a blue slice labeled “Efficient deployment” with the value “26.2s (30.08%)”. Both slices include numeric labels inside the segments showing seconds and percentages. The blue “Efficient deployment” segment appears slightly separated from the rest of the pie (exploded/offset), and there is no separate legend visible; the category text for “Efficient deployment” is placed outside near the blue slice.
